sidebar.profileHint: Default profile for chats (locked chats keep theirs)

home.favHint: Star characters to see them here

general.title: General
general.lead: App-wide preferences. Chat and Phone settings live in their own tabs.
general.checkUpdateDesc: Check GitHub releases for a newer version. Download manually from the release page.
general.checkOnStartDesc: Check GitHub once when the app starts and notify if an update is available.

budget.title: Budget
budget.lead: Monthly budget limits per API profile, usage totals, and model pricing table.
budget.noUsage: No API usage in this period
budget.priceHint: Set per-model pricing to display estimated costs next to usage.

lorebook.title: Lorebook
lorebook.lead: Configure World Info keyword scan depth and recursive activation depth.
lorebook.scanDepthDesc: Number of recent chat messages to scan for World Info keywords (1–200, default 2). Current user input is always included.
lorebook.maxDepthDesc: Maximum depth for recursively scanning activated World Info entries (0–10, 0 disables recursion).

music.dragHandle: Mini player drag handle. Use arrow keys to move.

tasks.budgetDetail: Change limits in Settings > Management > Budget
tasks.budgetOverrideToast: If you run again within 2 minutes, this one run will bypass the budget limit.

phone.name: Phone
phone.desc: Messenger-style phone screen to chat with characters and peek at their phone

game.name: Game Mode
game.desc: Create, import, and play interactive games (maps, events, NPC dialogue)

chat.images.name: Character Assets
chat.images.desc: Share character image assets with AI and display them in chat via <cg> tags

html.name: HTML Rendering
html.desc: Execute and render ```html``` code blocks from AI replies in a sandboxed view (includes JS)

regex.name: Regex
regex.desc: Find-and-replace message text with regular expressions (supports SillyTavern import)

widget.name: Widgets
widget.desc: Desktop overlay widgets (music player, mascot, etc.)

translate.name: Translate
translate.desc: Translate AI replies into your language and your input into another language using your AI

tts.name: Text-to-Speech
tts.desc: Read AI replies aloud using an OpenAI-compatible TTS API

imagegen.name: Image Generation
imagegen.desc: Generate images directly from the Images page or 'Draw this scene' on messages (NovelAI / OpenAI-compatible)

imageauto.name: Auto Image Generation
imageauto.desc: Have the writing AI append an image prompt and generate automatically after each reply (incurs image cost per reply)

sync.name: Sync
sync.desc: Exchange and merge characters, chats, and settings across devices via files (API keys are never shared)

lint.name: Message Linter
lint.desc: Check AI replies before saving for unclosed tags/quotes, repetition, impersonation, banned words, and length

memory.name: Memory Search
memory.desc: Search past conversations semantically (indexing sends text to your embedding provider)

summary.name: Memory Extension · Chat Summary
summary.desc: Summarize older messages outside the context window and pass them to AI automatically

rewrite.name: Auto Rewrite
rewrite.desc: Automatically regenerate a new swipe when the linter catches banned words or repetition (keeps original)

ghostwrite.name: Ghostwrite
ghostwrite.desc: Expand your rough draft into dialogue in your persona's voice inside the input box without sending

slash.name: Slash Commands & Quick Reply
slash.desc: Run / commands and scripts from the input bar (SillyTavern style)

status.name: Status Window & Variables
status.desc: Inspect and edit conversation variables and collect status windows in one view

community.name: Community Plugins
community.desc: Install custom or third-party plugins from files with isolated permissions
